message.subject: BarePlay Membership - Tentative Approval & Next Steps
message.previewText: Your BarePlay application has been tentatively approved. Here are the next steps.
message.body:
Hello {{name}},

Thank you for applying for membership with BarePlay. We are pleased to let you know that your application has been tentatively approved.

Final approval will be granted after your enrollment fee has been received and our background check process has been completed. Once those steps are finished, you will receive a follow-up email confirming your official membership status.

Please review the important information below to help you prepare for membership and future events.

1. Enrollment Fee and Background Check

Your membership becomes official after we receive your one-time enrollment fee of $25 per couple and complete the background check. The payment link is located at the bottom of the Membership page in Step 2. Enrollment fees are non-refundable, as they are used to cover the cost of the background screening.

2. Event Tickets

Please do not purchase tickets for any events until you have received your final approval email.

3. Test Results Requirement

Before attending your first event after final approval, please email us updated test results dated within 90 days of the event. Your first submission must include results for both partners.

4. No Smoking Or Vaping Policy

Our events are strictly non-smoking and non-vaping. This includes tobacco, cannabis, and any other substances, both indoors and outdoors.

5. Risk Awareness and Responsibility

While we require testing and aim to create a safer environment, no system can guarantee zero risk. All participants must understand and accept this reality.

We are looking forward to meeting you and building a trusted, respectful, and connected community together.

Warm regards,

Dan / Sophie / Sugar / Amanda

BarePlay

message.subject: BarePlay Membership - Final Approval Confirmed
message.previewText: Your BarePlay membership is now fully approved.
message.body:
Hello {{name}},

Great news. Your background check has been completed and you are now fully approved for membership with BarePlay. Welcome to our ever-growing circle of merrymakers.

Our upcoming party is scheduled for [DATE], and we would love to see you there if your schedule allows. Before attending, please remember to submit your current test results, dated within 90 days of the event, and purchase your ticket through the Events page on our website.

Our goal is to create a different kind of gathering, centered on connection, trust, emotional maturity, and mutual respect among like-minded people. We are building a community first, and a party second. We hope that intention resonates with you as much as it does us.

If you have any questions before your first event, feel free to reply anytime.

Looking forward to meeting you soon.

Warm regards,

Dan / Sophie / Sugar / Amanda

BarePlay

message.subject: BarePlay Party Reminder - [DATE] ([TIME])

Hey {{name}},

Just a quick reminder about our upcoming BarePlay party on [DATE] from [TIME].

If you have not submitted your test results yet, please reply to this email and attach them. Results must be dated within 90 days of the event. If you already submitted results for the last party and they are still within that 90-day window, you are all set.

A couple quick checklist items:

- Enrollment fee: if you have not paid yet, you can do so on the Membership page.
- Event ticket: be sure to grab your ticket from the Events page.

As a reminder, the process is:

1. Membership application.
2. One-time enrollment fee for background check.
3. Test results.
4. Event ticket purchase.

We are excited to keep building this community with you. Food and soft drinks will be available, and you are welcome to bring anything extra you would like.

Cheers,

Dan / Sophie / Sugar / Sage

message.subject: BarePlay Membership Inquiry Follow-Up
message.previewText: A follow-up about your BarePlay membership inquiry.
message.body:
Hi {{name}},

Thank you again for your interest in BarePlay and for taking the time to share more about yourselves with us.

After reviewing everything and looking at the way our events are currently structured, we do not think BarePlay is the right fit for you at this time. Our parties are built around a specific interaction format and compatibility model among attendees, and we try to be careful about maintaining that balance so expectations line up for everyone involved.

This is not a judgment of either of you personally. We appreciate your openness and wish you both the best in finding spaces that are a better match for what you are looking for.

Warmly,

Dan

BarePlay
